characters.name: Appanna
characters.look: Appanna, a 65-year-old Indian man with a round friendly face, deep laugh lines, short neatly combed white hair, a thick white mustache, wearing a crisp white cotton shirt and light grey veshti

characters.name: Chitti
characters.look: Chitti, a lively 10-year-old Indian girl with bright expressive eyes, long black hair tied in two pigtails with red ribbons, wearing a bright yellow cotton dress

episodes.title: రిపోర్ట్ కార్డ్ రహస్యం
episodes.summary: Appanna tries to inspect a hidden item under a plate, believing it to be a sweet box. Chitti panics and reveals it is actually her report card containing a zero in math just as her father arrives.

episodes.title: లెక్కల చిక్కులు
episodes.summary: Chitti and Appanna frantically try to hide the failed math report card before her father enters the room. Just as they manage to cover it under the sweet box, her father reaches directly for the box.

episodes.title: తండ్రి చేతిలో తీపి తినుబండారం
episodes.summary: Appanna and Chitti successfully convince her father not to touch the sweet box by pretending flies got into it. However, while trying to hide the report card, it slips onto the floor right in front of her father.

episodes.title: తాతా బిడ్డల జిత్తులు
episodes.summary: Appanna tries to stomp on the fallen math report card to hide it from Chitti's father, making wild excuses about a sore foot and a lost coin. Despite their chaotic efforts, Chitti's father bends down and picks up the report card right from under Appanna's hands.

episodes.title: తాతా మనవరాలి దొంగాట
episodes.summary: As Chitti's father unfolds the report card, Appanna tries one last absurd excuse to claim the zero mark is actually a drawing of spectacles. Unexpectedly, Chitti's father looks at the paper and bursts into laughter, leaving both Chitti and Appanna in complete shock.

episodes.title: నవ్వుల రహస్యం
episodes.summary: Appanna and Chitti are stunned when Chitti's father laughs because he also scored zero in his childhood. As they share a happy moment, a sudden new sound at the door creates a fresh surprise.

episodes.title: తలుపు వెనుక ఎవరు?
episodes.summary: As Appanna and Chitti panic about the knock at the door, they quickly hide the report card again. Upon opening the door, Appanna and Chitti are stunned to see Chitti's math teacher standing right outside with a bag.

episodes.title: మాథ్స్ టీచర్ రావడమా?
episodes.summary: Appanna and Chitti are terrified when Chitti's math teacher enters their home carrying a mysterious cloth bag. As they fear the worst about her failed marks, the teacher reaches inside the bag to pull out a large book.
